faq_heading: White Rock townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did townhomes in White Rock sell for?
faq.a: 13 townhomes sold in White Rock between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $885,250.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in White Rock?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in White Rock sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 13 townhomes that sold in White Rock went for between $730,000 and $1,057,777, around a median of $885,250.

faq.q: Do townhomes in White Rock sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 13 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.3% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in White Rock?
faq.a: Of the 13 sales, 13 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $464.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in White Rock?
faq.a: The median year built was 1998 for the 13 townhomes sold in White Rock.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in White Rock usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in White Rock had 3 bedrooms, from the 13 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What White Rock townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

13 townhomes sold in White Rock with a median price of $885,250 (the middle half sold between $730,000 and $1,057,777), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $565 per square foot, a median year built of 1998 and a median strata fee of $464 a month.
